title: Saudi Arabia accuses Houthis of targeting Mecca, warns of 'red line'
summary: Saudi Arabia accused Yemen's Houthis on Wednesday of launching a "cowardly" attack targeting Islam's holy city of Mecca, sparking outrage across the Muslim world.
